selection: Maximize mean of validation accuracy and macro F1, subject to macro F1 >= original validation F1, balanced accuracy >= original minus .03, usually/always recall >= .30. Original retained as fallback.
test_policy: Freeze all six selections before evaluating test once. Test was evaluated in the earlier project iteration, so this is a reused internal holdout, not new external validation.
probabilities: Class-prior-adjusted uncalibrated estimates, not clinically calibrated probabilities.
